messages:
aditya: Heads-up — noticed a spike in dashboard LCP and sparkline jank right after we rolled the routing weight tweak to favor eu1. Charts hang for ~600ms longer on first paint. https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/UX/console-lcp?panelId=7 :eyes:

maria: Oof. Which rollout was that? Canary id?

aditya: Canary 2026-03-12-rtw. Deployed ~1765438800. Small change in routing weights to bias eu region for cheaper capacity. Repro steps: open a dashboard with 8 sparklines, cold load, see main thread spike.

sato: pinging the deploy bot + checking traces. Do you have a HAR or trace?

aditya: quick trace attached (small snippet):
```
MainThread: parse(80ms) -> eval(120ms) -> render(300ms) -> paint-block(620ms)
Network: assets ok (cacheable).
Imported libs: telemetry-client, embedlib, sparklines-core
```

deploy-bot: Canary 2026-03-12-rtw rolled to eu1=0.65, na1=0.25, fallback=0.10 at 1765438803 by maria. No automatic rollback. :robot_face:

maria: Thanks. sato, any obvious routing->client link? Routing shouldn't change client bundle.

sato: Looks like the eu routing bumped traffic to a host pool that has a slightly older edge config which still loads the telemetry-sidecar inlined chunk. That sidecar import bloats initial module graph and causes parse+eval hit for firstpaint. I can repro locally by forcing the sidecar import on first render.

kevin: Wait — why would routing change edge config? Aren't configs synced?
sato: They are, but there's a staggered config rollout to edge nodes. eu1 pool missed the lazy-split flag for telemetry. So when clients hit eu1 they get telemetry bundled eagerly.
aditya: Ah — that explains inconsistency across regions. So the weight change just amplified the population hitting the out-of-date pool.

maria: Can we flip the routing weights back temporarily? Or do a forced config sync to eu1?

sato: Fastest is flip weights back to previous percentages. Forced sync is riskier and slower.

aditya: I can flip weights now if y'all agree. Quick patch:
```json
{"eu1":0.3,"na1":0.6,"fallback":0.1}
```

telemetry-bot: Telemetry sampling note — we observed a 3x increase in client sampling for sparklines starting at 1765438850 (canary window). Might be related.

kevin: If we flip weights back, add a short TTL on routing so we can verify metrics within 10m and revert easily. Also open a bug for edge config drift.

aditya: On it. Pushing weight revert now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Routing weights updated by aditya at 1765439202: eu1=0.30, na1=0.60, fallback=0.10.

maria: Monitoring dashboard — give it 5–10 minutes then check LCP heatmap.

sato: I'll follow up with infra to force the lazy-split flag sync to eu1 and add a preflight check to ensure new edge gets the correct bundle manifest before routing weight increases.

aditya: Quick follow-up: reproduced locally by toggling `TELEMETRY_EAGER_IMPORT=true` — when true, parse+eval +120ms, paint +450ms. So confirm it's the eager import.

kevin: Action items: 1) rollback weights (done), 2) infra sync for lazy-split flag (sato), 3) add an edge-config drift alert (maria), 4) open postmortem and add canary gating for edge manifest parity (aditya).

aditya: Creating issue and assigning owners. Issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/876 :memo:

maria: Thanks team. Keep reactions and short updates here. :thumbsup:
